title: Antihistamines, Amantadine and Evolution of COVID-19
official: Evaluation of Treatments With Antihistamines and Amantadine in the Evolution of the SARS-CoV-2 Infection
summary: The rates of symptomatic COVID19 infection, hospital admission among COVID19 cases and survival would be quantified in patiens chronically treated with antihistamines or amantadine, with the aim of determining the role of antihistamines and amantadine in the evolution of COVID19.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Patients having chronic treatment with antihistamines or amantadine -

Exclusion Criteria: None
